# Keep MV3 provider result values distinct from MV2 flat cards

Accepted provider code treats MV3 results as vCard strings. In MV2, an explicit vCard property takes precedence over flat properties. It sets directoryUID on each card, reports the supplied isCompleteResult after successful delivery and translates caught conversion/dispatch failures to onSearchFinished. Preserve those versioned representations and completion signals. The wakeup await is outside that try block, so this does not prove that wake-up failures finish the search. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Extension provider result conversion.
